editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "右翼选择党（AfD）政治人物马蒂亚斯·赫尔费里希（Matthias Helferich）的一场活动在杜塞尔多夫引发了画廊、剧院和歌剧院的抗议。数百人聚集在歌德博物馆前", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "杜塞尔多夫右翼选择党（AfD）与备受争议的联邦议院议员马蒂亚斯·赫尔费里希（Matthias Helferich）共同举行的一场文化巡游，引发了这座北莱茵-威斯特法伦州首府文化机构的强烈抗议。周一下午，数百人在“杜塞尔多夫追求民主的文化”口号下，自发组织了一场“公开文化项目”，聚集在歌德博物馆前。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "当赫尔费里希出现在该博物馆（这也是选择党巡游的起点）时，现场响起了嘘声和高呼声。在大量警察的护送下，选择党从歌德博物馆出发，沿着城市最重要的文化机构一路“漫步”，直至卡尔施塔特的维特根斯坦宫（Palais Wittgenstein）。赫尔费里希原计划稍后在那里发表关于“右翼文化政策”的演讲。据警方称，报名参加选择党巡游的约有40人。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "据警方估计，反抗议者的数量多达700至800人。他们一路跟随选择党队伍穿过市中心。据德新社记者报道，其间还发生了推搡冲突。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "根据宪法，并不存在所谓的“右翼文化政策”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "杜塞尔多夫话剧院（Düsseldorfer Schauspielhaus）艺术总监安德烈亚斯·卡拉加尼斯（Andreas Karlaganis）在反抗议活动中表示，任何要求或梦想“右翼文化政策”的人都站在宪法之外。卡拉加尼斯强调：“从民主理解的角度来看，文化政策不可能是右翼的，正如它不可能是左翼的，或者介于两者之间以及之外一样。”因为根据基本法，艺术、科学、研究和教学是自由的。卡拉加尼斯说：“当艺术和文化被拉拢为意识形态服务、被强加这些目的并从属于这些目的时，它们就不复存在了。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "杜塞尔多夫的文化工作者希望通过包含音乐、文学和戏剧节目的集会，为开放和民主的社会表明态度。抗议呼吁书写道：“艺术是抗争、多样性和自由——它必须经受住模棱两可的考验，并抵制任何被意识形态收编的企图。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "关于杜塞尔多夫活动地点的争议", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在此之前，围绕赫尔费里希在杜塞尔多夫的活动地点曾发生过争议。这位选择党政治人物最初计划在海因里希·海涅研究所（Heinrich-Heine-Institut）发表演讲，但该计划已被取消。据市政府称，该研究所当时正在进行改建工程，导致多场活动不得不改期。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "北威州选择党地方支部曾在夏天试图将被称为极右翼的赫尔费里希开除出党，但未能成功。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在其网站上，杜塞尔多夫选择党使用了一张该市著名历史人物海涅的照片。生于杜塞尔多夫的海因里希·海涅（1797-1856）曾为躲避反犹主义者和民族主义者而流亡巴黎。这位犹太诗曾是民族主义和大日耳曼沙文主义的尖锐批评者。", "translated": true}]

article_text:
Ein Auftritt des AfD-Politikers Matthias Helferich ruft in Düsseldorf Protest von Galerien, Theater und Oper hervor. Hunderte versammeln sich vor dem Goethe-Museum

Ein Kulturrundgang der Düsseldorfer AfD zusammen mit dem umstrittenen Bundestagsabgeordneten Matthias Helferich hat lauten Gegenprotest der Kulturinstitutionen in der nordrhein-westfälischen Landeshauptstadt ausgelöst. Mehrere hundert Menschen versammelten sich am Montagnachmittag vor dem Goethe-Museum unter dem Motto "Düsseldorfer Kultur für Demokratie" zu einem spontan organisierten "öffentlichen Kulturprogramm".

Als Helferich an dem Museum auftrat, das auch Ausgangspunkt für den AfD-Rundgang war, ertönten Pfiffe und laute Rufe. Vom Goethe-Museum aus startete die AfD begleitet von einem massiven Polizeiaufgebot zu einem "Spaziergang" entlang der wichtigsten Kulturinstitutionen der Stadt bis zum Palais Wittgenstein in der Carlstadt. Dort sollte Helferich später einen Vortrag über "Kulturpolitik von rechts" halten. Angemeldet zu dem AfD-Rundgang waren laut Polizei etwa 40 Personen.

Die Polizei schätzte die Zahl der Gegendemonstranten auf bis zu 700 oder 800. Sie folgten der AfD-Gruppe auf dem Weg durch die Innenstadt. Dabei kam es auch zu Rangeleien, wie ein dpa-Reporter berichtete.

"Rechte Kulturpolitik" gibt es laut Verfassung nicht

Wer «"rechte Kulturpolitik" fordere oder erträume, stehe außerhalb der Verfassung, sagte der Intendant des Düsseldorfer Schauspielhauses, Andreas Karlaganis, bei dem Gegenprotest. "Kulturpolitik in einem demokratischen Verständnis kann nicht von rechts sein, genauso wenig übrigens wie sie von links sein kann oder von dazwischen und außerhalb", betonte Karlaganis. Denn Kunst, Wissenschaft, Forschung und Lehre seien laut Grundgesetz frei. "Und wo Kunst und Kultur für ideologische Zwecke eingespannt, diesen Zwecken dienstbar gemacht und untergeordnet werden sollen, hören sie auf zu existieren", sagte Karlaganis.

Mit einem Programm aus Musik, Literatur und Theater wollten die Düsseldorfer Kulturschaffenden bei der Kundgebung ein Zeichen für eine offene und demokratische Gesellschaft setzen. "Kunst ist Widerspruch, Vielfalt und Freiheit – sie muss das Uneindeutige aushalten und sich jeder Vereinnahmung durch Ideologien widersetzen", hieß es in dem Protestaufruf.

Streit um Auftrittsort in Düsseldorf

Vorausgegangen war ein Streit um den Auftrittsort Helferichs in Düsseldorf. Ursprünglich sollte der AfD-Politiker im Heinrich-Heine-Institut reden. Das wurde aber abgesagt. Nach Angaben der Stadt standen in dem Institut Umbauarbeiten an, wodurch mehrere Veranstaltungen verlegt werden mussten.

Der Landesverband der NRW-AfD war im Sommer damit gescheitert, den als äußerst rechts geltenden Helferich aus der Partei auszuschließen.

Auf ihrer Website wirbt die Düsseldorfer AfD mit einem Bild des berühmten Stadtsohns Heine. Der gebürtige Düsseldorfer Heinrich Heine (1797-1856) war einst vor Antisemiten und Nationalisten ins Pariser Exil geflüchtet. Der jüdische Dichter war ein scharfzüngiger Kritiker von Nationalismus und Deutschtümelei.

title_original: Michael Mann Accidentally Shoots Himself in Leg at Los Angeles Gun Range
editorial_title_zh: 迈克尔·曼在洛杉矶射击场不慎腿部中枪，已入院治疗
editorial_excerpt_zh: 这位曾执导《盗火线》和《惊爆内幕》并获奥斯卡提名的导演接受了“表皮轻伤”的治疗。
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "曾执导《盗火线》和《惊爆内幕》的导演迈克尔·曼于周六在洛杉矶的一处射击场不慎腿部中枪。", "links": [{"text": "Michael Mann", "url": "https://www.indiewire.com/t/michael-mann/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "该电影制片人的一位发言人表示，“一把枪在枪套内意外走火，导致表皮轻伤。”曼在当地一家医院接受了皮下轻伤的治疗，目前正准备出院。这起事件发生于靶场练习期间。曼是一位经验丰富的射击手，在靶场练习已有数十年历史。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "洛杉矶警方的一位发言人表示，警员们于下午4点左右接到报警，前往“The Range LA”处理一起“开枪”事件。经调查确定，此次枪击事件属于“意外”。TMZ网站率先报道了这一消息。", "links": [{"text": "broke the news", "url": "https://www.tmz.com/2026/11/01/michael-mann-accidentally-shoots-himself-in-leg/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "现年83岁的曼以执导硬汉风格的犯罪故事而闻名，其中许多作品聚焦警察与罪犯，并以城市景观为背景。凭借1999年的新闻惊悚片《惊爆内幕》，他获得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖提名，该片亦获最佳影片提名。曼的其他代表作包括《大盗》（1981）、《猎人者》（1986）、《最后的莫希干人》（1992）、《拳王阿里》（2001）、《借刀杀人》（2004）以及《公众之敌》（2009）。作为制片人，曼曾因马丁·斯科塞斯2004年的剧情片《飞行家》获得奥斯卡提名。", "links": [{"text": "film", "url": "https://www.indiewire.com/t/film/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "曼最近的作品是2023年的《法拉利》，他即将拍摄一部根据他与梅格·加德纳合著小说改编的《盗火线》续集。该片将由克里斯蒂安·贝尔、莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和斯蒂芬·格拉汉姆主演。曼还曾参与创作80年代热门电视剧《迈阿密风云》，并随后执导了该剧的电影版。", "translated": true}]

article_text:
Michael Mann , the director of “Heat” and “The Insider,” shot himself in the leg at a Los Angeles gun range on Saturday.

A spokesperson for the filmmaker said that “a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury.” Mann was treated at a local hospital for a wound that was subcutaneous and minor. He is being released. The event took place during target practice. Mann is an experienced shooter who has been practicing on ranges for decades.

A spokesperson for the Los Angeles said that officers had responded to a “shots fired” incident at The Range LA at roughly 4 p.m. An investigation determined that the shooting was “accidental.” TMZ broke the news of the shooting.

The 83-year-old Mann is known for directing gritty crime stories, many of which look at cops and criminals and are set in urban landscapes. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director for his work on the 1999 journalism thriller “The Insider” and the film was nominated for Best Picture. Mann’s other credits include “Thief “(1981), “Manhunter” (1986), “The Last of the Mohicans” (1992), “Ali” (2001), “Collateral” (2004), and “Public Enemies” (2009). As a producer, Mann received an Oscar nomination for Martin Scorsese’s 2004 drama “The Aviator.”

Mann’s most recent credit was 2023’s “Ferrari” and he is about to shoot a sequel to “Heat” that is based on a novel he co-wrote with Meg Gardiner. That film will star Christian Bale, Leonardo DiCaprio, and Stephen Graham. Mann also helped create the ’80s TV hit “Miami Vice” and later directed a film version of the show.
excerpt_original: The Oscar-nominated director of "Heat" and "The Insider" was treated for a "superficial injury."

title_original: ¡ESTO ES TAN DIDÁCTICO!
editorial_title_zh: 这就是说教！
editorial_excerpt_zh: 在这篇随笔中，巴勃罗·埃尔格拉（Pablo Helguera）审视了“说教”这一当代艺术中最常被使用却最少得到定义的指责之一，并将其解读为一场关于谁有权赋予意义的争论。他区分了解释过度的作品与为内部人士加密的作品，……
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "阅读时间：9分钟", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "[短篇阅读]", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在这篇随笔中，巴勃罗·埃尔格拉（Pablo Helguera）审视了“说教”这一当代艺术中最常被使用却最少得到定义的指责之一，并将其解读为一场关于谁有权赋予意义的争论。他区分了解释过度的作品与为内部人士加密的作品，并认为这两种作品都剥夺了观众的主体性。他的替代方案是一件能够为公众着想、并相信能与陌生人共同构建意义的作品，尽管这可能带来误解的风险。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我的思绪常常会回到那些在现代艺术博物馆（MoMA）凯西·哈尔布雷希（Kathy Halbreich）担任副馆长期间我参加过的策展会议——私密且闭门举行。她过去常常鼓励就艺术家、展览和理念展开热烈的辩论，并乐于倾听可能出现的不同意见。我们与她讨论某件特定作品并不是什么稀罕事，甚至有时还能说服她重新考虑自己的立场。然而，却有一种评判似乎是无可上诉的。偶尔，凯西会非常谨慎地将一件作品——或者更糟，整个展览——归类为“说教”。她带着一种庄严的镇定说出这个词，回想起来，这让我有点想起电影《穿普拉达的女王》。一旦她把这个词说出口，谈话便会自动终止。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "形容词“说教”已成为当代艺术中最常被调用却最少被分析的批判之一。它极少得到明确定义，而是变成了一个囊括一系列反对意见的通用术语：即一件作品是在告诉观众该想什么，而不是邀请他们去思考；它是道德说教式的或过于好为人师的。它不过是对某种政治立场的单纯图解，而不是——无论如何——将这种立场转化为一种审美体验。或者说，它给解释留下的空间太小了；亦或是它投射出某种道德确定性。通过将这些本身过于异质的反对意见简化为一个单一的形容词，艺术评论往往掩盖了那个最有趣的问题：究竟是什么，让一件艺术品被感知为具有说教意味的？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这个词多年来一直困扰着我。我经常发现自己在为被指控为“说教”的作品辩护，包括我自己的作品在内，却从来不觉得这种指控本身得到了充分的定义。相反，我直觉地感到它被抛出的态度过于轻率。我甚至曾想象过蒂诺·塞加尔（Tino Sehgal）的一件作品，其中的表演者在博物馆的展厅里游荡，反复宣告的不再是“这太当代了！”，而仅仅是“这太说教了！”。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "与其去质疑一件作品是否具有说教意味，我一直在追问的是这个词与当代艺术内部更深层次的分裂之间的关系：谁拥有创造意义的权力。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "源自希腊语didaktikos（意为“适合教学的”），“说教”一词最初没有任何负面内涵。卢克莱修的《物性论》（De Rerum Natura）就自豪地具有说教性质，中世纪和文艺复兴时期的许多艺术亦是如此。这一含义随着启蒙运动关于审美自主性的观念而开始发生变化，并最终在现代主义对自主艺术品的辩护中占据核心地位。到了20世纪末——随着政治、女权主义和具有社会参与性的实践对形式主义假设提出挑战，“说教”已成为艺术界最可靠的排斥手段之一：一个可以意味着道德说教、图解式、笨拙或仅仅是“政治色彩过浓”的词。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果通过主体性问题来追溯这个词的历史，就会出现一个相当耐人寻味的模式。在古代，权威很大程度上在于导师。启蒙运动则偏爱审美判断。现代主义将权威赋予了自主的艺术品以及那些受过训练去解释它们的人。相比之下，当代艺术则渴望将意义重新安置在观众身上。然而，这种渴望仍然是争议的对象。策展人、评论家、理论家、艺术家、收藏家和教育工作者继续争夺着谁拥有批准对艺术品进行解释的权威。这样看下来，“说教”一词的历史，实际上就是关于究竟谁最终被允许创造意义的历史。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这并不是说这种指控总是毫无根据的。事实上，有大量的当代艺术似乎主要由纯粹的解释构成：那些比起审美体验，更像是公开声明的作品。它们类似于开麦之夜的艺术家，将忏悔与沟通混为一谈，对待公众与其说是作为观众或对话者，不如说是作为个人宣泄的被动见证人。它们非但没有邀请解释，反而只求获得认可或赞同。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "最令我感兴趣的是，这种倾向并非源于自信，而是源于某种焦虑。这类作品在误解发生之前就已预料到它，并急于自我解释，以此来免疫任何模糊性。它们没有把观众请进对话，而是把观众纳进了一个已经得出的结论中。有些展览的运作方式似乎遵循西弗勒斯·斯内普（Severus Snape）的教育哲学：人们一进入这个空间，便处于一种预设的罪责状态中，仿佛默认自己未通过一场其问题从未被揭晓的道德考试。作品要求观众在赢得其劝说自身价值的权利之前，先向其屈服。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "然而，我发现自己对其中许多作品依然怀有同情。它们的冲动通常是真诚的。如果某个议题确实占据了公共领域，艺术家不仅有权参与该对话，甚至可能负有责任。坚持让艺术置身于时事之外，无非是维持一种它能够独立于历史存在并运作的幻想。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Rodney-Graham.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "罗德尼·格雷厄姆（Rodney Graham），《传媒研究 ’77》（Media Studies ’77），2016年。两块带背面安装彩色透明片的喷漆铝制灯箱。每块面板尺寸：232,2 x 182 x 17,8 厘米。安大略美术馆。菲利普·B·林德（Philip B. Lind）遗产捐赠，2024年。© 罗德尼·格雷厄姆遗产，由里森画廊（Lisson Gallery）惠允。2024/48", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "无论如何，我最担忧的是相反的倾向：将社会批判编码为极其繁复、几乎无法解密的观念语言的作品。这里的辩论悬于两万英尺的高空，以如此抽象的方式调用“权力”、“系统”或“暴力”等词汇，以至于它们似乎可以指代几乎任何环境——从而也无法特指任何特定的环境。在这里，意义仅为那些已经精通其密码的人而存在。有些展览给人的印象是，它们的设计与其说是为了普通公众，不如说是为了其他策展人、评论家和理论家。在占据公共机构的同时，主要为自己的同辈从事策展工作，就是将复杂性与排他性混为一谈。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这就是悖论所在：晦涩可以和显露一样具有说服力。隐瞒信息的作品甚至可能比过度解释的作品更具说服力。它不是告诉我们该想什么，而是宣称意义存在于别处，存在于一个足够神秘、使我们永远无法被接纳其中的密码之中。它让我们充分意识到，某个后台正举行着一场我们未获邀请的知识盛宴。它建立的不是对话，而是一场入会仪式。它不是要求我们独立思考，而是让我们去惊叹他人已经完成了思考的工作。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因此，真正的对立既不是政治艺术与非政治艺术之间的对立，也不是清晰与模糊之间的对立。它存在于无对话的教学法与无慷慨的神秘感之间。我们都喜欢神秘，但不喜欢排他性的神秘。我们会被那些吸引我们、邀请我们走入其中却又不把对所有模糊之处的解答直接奉上的作品所吸引。艺术向我们呈递的是一个问题，而非一个结论。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "为了实现这一点，一件作品必须提供一些切入途径。它必须公开思考。它不能仅仅为我们提供一个政治讨论的话题，也不能把自己表现为一个严密密封的黑盒，其意义仅为少数内部人士所保留。在这两种情况下，观众都被剥夺了行动的能力：一件作品告诉我们该想什么；而另一件则告诉我们，思考属于别人。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我将此称为梅西百货原则（The Principle of Macy’s）。梅西百货的橱窗旨在用我们无法立即拥有的物品来诱惑我们。某些展览似乎也发挥着类似的知识功能。它们的公共性质并非为了扩大参与，而是为了将无法企及的知识展示为一种文化阶级标志。博物馆不再是一个公共论坛，而是变成了一个陈列专业知识的展厅。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "每一件艺术品归根结底都是一次信仰的跃升。一旦它进入世界，艺术家便放弃了对其意义的主权。企图预先决定解释或将其留给少数特权阶层，都是对这种状态的变相拒绝。因此，说教性的对立面既不是模糊性，也不是自信。若要说有什么对立面的话，那就是一种确信：作品能够进入公共领域，而无需预先确定谁将是它的受众。它的意义是开放的，并且可以与陌生人共同构建，而不仅仅与那些已经认同其政治承诺或观念词汇的人共同构建。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这种信任至关重要，因为仅在其自身解释社群内部流通的作品很少经受考验。无论它们是对信徒说教还是只针对内部人士，它们都与那些可能深化、使之复杂化甚至推翻其假设的相遇隔绝开来。艺术值得拥有稍微艰难一点的生活。它应当甘冒误解、分歧甚至失败的风险，如果作为交换，它能为真正诚实的公共对话打开可能性的话。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "与其说是确定性，不如说是敞开心扉，准备好被公众改造，一如改造公众：这或许才是说教主义真正的反义词。归根结底，艺术家需要陌生人，并非因为陌生人总能理解作品，而是因为他们会以一种不同的方式去理解。如果我们运气够好，他们会馈赠我们那样一种极其稀缺的礼物：来自陌生公众的批评善意。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "翻译：弗兰·库斯（Fran Cus）", "links": [{"text": "Fran Cus", "url": "https://www.instagram.com/cuscusilly/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "最初发表于《Beautiful Eccentrics》", "links": [{"text": "Beautiful Eccentrics", "url": "https://pablohelguera.substack.com/p/this-is-so-didactic"}], "translated": true}]

Algunas exposiciones dan la impresión de estar diseñadas menos para el público general que para otros curadores, críticos y teóricos. Realizar el trabajo de curaduría fundamentalmente para los propios pares mientras se ocupa una institución pública es confundir complejidad con exclusividad."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Y ahí radica la paradoja: la opacidad puede ser tan didáctica como la explicitud. La obra que oculta información puede ser incluso más didáctica que la que se explica en exceso. En lugar de decirnos qué pensar, declara que el significado existe en otra parte, en un código lo suficientemente críptico como para no ser nunca admitidos en él. Nos hace tomar plena conciencia de que hay una especie de fiesta intelectual sucediendo en algún detrás de escena y a la que no hemos sido invitados. No establece una conversación sino un ritual de iniciación. No nos pide que pensemos por nosotros mismos, sino que admiremos el hecho de que otros ya hayan hecho el trabajo de pensar."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "La verdadera oposición, entonces, no es entre el arte político y el apolítico, ni entre la claridad y la ambigüedad. Nos atraen las obras que nos seducen, que nos invitan a entrar en ella sin dejarnos servidas las respuestas a todas sus opacidades. El arte nos presenta un problema en lugar de una conclusión."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Para que eso suceda, una obra debe ofrecer algunas vías de entrada. Debe pensar en público. No puede limitarse a ofrecernos un tema de discusión política, ni puede presentarse como una caja negra sellada herméticamente, cuyo significado está reservado solo para los iniciados. En ambos casos se le niega al espectador la capacidad de actuar: una obra nos dice qué pensar; la otra nos dice que el pensamiento le pertenece a otra persona."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "A esto lo denomino el Principio de Macy’s. Una vez que entra al mundo, el artista renuncia a la soberanía sobre su significado. Los intentos de predeterminar la interpretación o de reservarla para unos pocos privilegiados son diferentes formas del rechazo a esa condición. Lo opuesto al didactismo, entonces, no es ni la ambigüedad ni la confianza. En todo caso, la oposición está dada por una cierta seguridad de que la obra puede ingresar a la esfera pública sin predeterminar quién será su público. Que el significado de la misma está abierto y se puede construir con extraños, y no solo con quienes ya comparten sus compromisos políticos o su vocabulario conceptual."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Esa confianza es importante porque las obras que circulan únicamente dentro de sus propias comunidades interpretativas rara vez se ponen a prueba. Ya sea que prediquen a los conversos o se dirijan solo a los iniciados, permanecen aisladas de los mismos encuentros que podrían profundizar, complicar o incluso revocar sus supuestos. El arte merece una vida un poco más difícil que esa. Al final, los artistas necesitan a los desconocidos, no porque los desconocidos siempre vayan a entender la obra, sino porque la entenderán de una manera diferente. article_text:
Tiempo de lectura: 9 minutos

[lectura breve]

En este ensayo, Pablo Helguera examina el adjetivo «didáctico», uno de los reproches más usados y menos definidos del arte contemporáneo, y lo lee como una disputa sobre quién autoriza el significado. Distingue la obra que se explica en exceso de la que se cifra para iniciados, y sostiene que ambas le niegan agencia al espectador. Su alternativa es una obra que piense en el público y confíe en construir sentido con desconocidos, aunque eso implique el riesgo del malentendido.

Mi mente suele volver a esas reuniones curatoriales —íntimas y a puerta cerrada— a las que asistí en el MoMA cuando Kathy Halbreich era directora Asociada. Ella solía fomentar debates animados sobre artistas, exposiciones e ideas, abierta a la escucha de los desacuerdos que pudieran presentarse. No era nada raro que discutiéramos con ella sobre una obra en particular, y hasta solía ocurrir que la convenciéramos de que revisara sus posiciones. Sin embargo, había un juicio contra el cual parecía no haber apelación. De vez en cuando, Kathy calificaba —con mucha discreción— una obra —o peor aún, una exposición completa— de «didáctica». Pronunciaba esa palabra con una compostura solemne que, en retrospectiva, me recuerda un poco a la película El diablo viste a la moda. Una vez que ella la pronunciaba, la conversación quedaba automáticamente cancelada.

El adjetivo «didáctico» se ha convertido en una de las críticas más frecuentemente invocadas —y menos analizadas— en el arte contemporáneo. Rara vez definido, se ha transformado en un término genérico que agrupa una serie de objeciones: que una obra les dice a los espectadores qué pensar en lugar de invitarlos a pensar; que es moralista o que sermonea demasiado. Que no pasa de ser una mera ilustración de una postura política en lugar de —en todo caso— transformar dicha posición en una experiencia estética. O que deja muy poco espacio para la interpretación; o que proyecta algún tipo de certeza moral. Al reducir estas objeciones —demasiado heterogéneas entre sí— a un solo adjetivo, la crítica de arte a menudo oculta la pregunta más interesante: ¿qué es, precisamente, lo que hace que una obra de arte se perciba como didáctica?

El término me ha atormentado durante muchos años. A menudo me he encontrado defendiendo obras acusadas de ser «didácticas», incluidas las mías, sin sentir nunca que la acusación en sí estuviera adecuadamente definida. Más bien, intuía que se lanzaba demasiado a la ligera. Incluso he llegado a imaginar una pieza de Tino Sehgal en la que los intérpretes deambulan por las galerías de un museo declarando repetidamente ya no «¡Esto es tan contemporáneo!», sino simplemente «¡Esto es tan didáctico!».

En lugar de preguntarme si una obra es didáctica, me he interrogado sobre esa palabra en relación con una división aún más profunda al interior del arte contemporáneo: quién tiene la facultad de crear significado .

Derivado del griego didaktikos («apto para enseñar»), el término «didáctico» no tenía originalmente ninguna connotación negativa. El De Rerum Natura (Sobre la naturaleza de las cosas) de Lucrecio era orgullosamente didáctico, al igual que gran parte del arte medieval y renacentista. El significado comienza a modificarse con las ideas de la Ilustración sobre la autonomía estética, y termina por volverse central en la defensa que hace el modernismo de la obra de arte autónoma. Hacia finales del siglo XX —y a medida que las prácticas políticas, feministas y socialmente comprometidas desafiaban los supuestos formalistas—, «didáctico» se había convertido en uno de los rechazos más confiables del mundo del arte: una palabra que podía significar moralista, ilustrativa, torpe o simplemente «demasiado política».

Si se rastrea la historia del término a través de la cuestión de la agencia, aparece un patrón bastante intrigante. En la Antigüedad, la autoridad residía en gran medida en el maestro. La Ilustración privilegió el juicio estético. El modernismo otorgó autoridad a la obra de arte autónoma y a quienes estaban capacitados para interpretarla. El arte contemporáneo, por el contrario, aspira a reubicar el significado en el espectador. Sin embargo, esa aspiración sigue siendo objeto de controversia. Curadores, críticos, teóricos, artistas, coleccionistas y educadores continúan compitiendo por quién detenta la autoridad para autorizar una interpretación sobre la obra de arte. Así vista, la historia del término «didáctico» es, en realidad, la historia de quién en definitiva tiene permiso para crear significado.

Esto no quiere decir que la acusación sea siempre infundada. De hecho, hay una gran cantidad de arte contemporáneo que parece consistir principalmente en puras explicaciones: obras que se perciben menos como experiencias estéticas que como declaraciones públicas. Se asemejan al artista de micrófono abierto, que confunde la confesión con la comunicación, tratando al público menos como espectadores o interlocutores que como testigos pasivos de una catarsis personal. En lugar de invitar a la interpretación, solo piden reconocimiento o asentimiento.

Lo que más me interesa es que esta tendencia no surge de la confianza, sino más bien de un cierto tipo de ansiedad. Dichas obras anticipan el malentendido antes de que ocurra y se apresuran a explicarse, inmunizándose contra toda ambigüedad. En lugar de invitar a los espectadores a una conversación, los incorporan a una conclusión a la que ya se ha llegado. Algunas exposiciones parecen funcionar bajo la filosofía pedagógica de Severus Snape: uno ya entra al espacio en estado de culpabilidad anticipada, con la presunción de haber reprobado un examen ético cuyas preguntas nunca se revelaron. La obra le pide al espectador que se someta a ella antes de haberse ganado el derecho a persuadirlo de su valor.

Me sucede que, sin embargo, sigo sintiendo simpatía por muchas de estas obras. Su impulso suele ser sincero. Si un tema ocupa genuinamente la esfera pública, los artistas no solo tienen el derecho, sino quizás la responsabilidad de sumarse a esa conversación. Insistir en que el arte permanezca al margen de los acontecimientos actuales es simplemente preservar la ilusión de que puede existir y operar por fuera de la historia.

En todo caso, lo que más me preocupa es la tendencia opuesta: obras que codifican la crítica social en un lenguaje conceptual tan enrevesado que resulta casi imposible de descifrar. Aquí el debate se mantiene a veinte mil pies de altura, invocando términos como «poder», «sistemas» o «violencia» de manera tan abstracta que parecen poder referirse a casi cualquier circunstancia —y, por lo tanto, a ninguna en particular—. Aquí, el significado existe solo para quienes ya están iniciados en sus códigos. Algunas exposiciones dan la impresión de estar diseñadas menos para el público general que para otros curadores, críticos y teóricos. Realizar el trabajo de curaduría fundamentalmente para los propios pares mientras se ocupa una institución pública es confundir complejidad con exclusividad.

Y ahí radica la paradoja: la opacidad puede ser tan didáctica como la explicitud. La obra que oculta información puede ser incluso más didáctica que la que se explica en exceso. En lugar de decirnos qué pensar, declara que el significado existe en otra parte, en un código lo suficientemente críptico como para no ser nunca admitidos en él. Nos hace tomar plena conciencia de que hay una especie de fiesta intelectual sucediendo en algún detrás de escena y a la que no hemos sido invitados. No establece una conversación sino un ritual de iniciación. No nos pide que pensemos por nosotros mismos, sino que admiremos el hecho de que otros ya hayan hecho el trabajo de pensar.

La verdadera oposición, entonces, no es entre el arte político y el apolítico, ni entre la claridad y la ambigüedad. Es entre la pedagogía sin diálogo y el misterio sin generosidad. A todos nos encanta el misterio, pero no el que excluye. Nos atraen las obras que nos seducen, que nos invitan a entrar en ella sin dejarnos servidas las respuestas a todas sus opacidades. El arte nos presenta un problema en lugar de una conclusión.

Para que eso suceda, una obra debe ofrecer algunas vías de entrada. Debe pensar en público. No puede limitarse a ofrecernos un tema de discusión política, ni puede presentarse como una caja negra sellada herméticamente, cuyo significado está reservado solo para los iniciados. En ambos casos se le niega al espectador la capacidad de actuar: una obra nos dice qué pensar; la otra nos dice que el pensamiento le pertenece a otra persona.

A esto lo denomino el Principio de Macy’s. Las vidrieras de las tiendas Macy’s están diseñadas para seducirnos con cosas que no podemos poseer de inmediato. Ciertas exposiciones parecen cumplir una función intelectual similar. Su carácter público no sirve para ampliar la participación, sino para exhibir conocimiento inaccesible como una forma de distinción cultural. El museo deja de ser un foro público para convertirse en una sala de exhibición de conocimientos especializados.

Toda obra de arte es, en última instancia, un acto de fe. Una vez que entra al mundo, el artista renuncia a la soberanía sobre su significado. Los intentos de predeterminar la interpretación o de reservarla para unos pocos privilegiados son diferentes formas del rechazo a esa condición. Lo opuesto al didactismo, entonces, no es ni la ambigüedad ni la confianza. En todo caso, la oposición está dada por una cierta seguridad de que la obra puede ingresar a la esfera pública sin predeterminar quién será su público. Que el significado de la misma está abierto y se puede construir con extraños, y no solo con quienes ya comparten sus compromisos políticos o su vocabulario conceptual.

Esa confianza es importante porque las obras que circulan únicamente dentro de sus propias comunidades interpretativas rara vez se ponen a prueba. Ya sea que prediquen a los conversos o se dirijan solo a los iniciados, permanecen aisladas de los mismos encuentros que podrían profundizar, complicar o incluso revocar sus supuestos. El arte merece una vida un poco más difícil que esa. Debería estar dispuesto a arriesgarse a los malentendidos, al desacuerdo e incluso al fracaso si, a cambio, logra abrirse a la posibilidad de una conversación pública genuina y honesta.

No tanto la certeza, sino la apertura a dejarse transformar por el público tanto como a transformarlo: quizás sea este el verdadero antónimo del didactismo. Al final, los artistas necesitan a los desconocidos, no porque los desconocidos siempre vayan a entender la obra, sino porque la entenderán de una manera diferente. Y si tenemos un poco de suerte, nos ofrecerán ese regalo tan escaso: la amabilidad crítica de públicos desconocidos.

Traducción: Fran Cus

article_text:
The European Film Academy has unveiled the shortlist of films in the running for prizes at its 39th European Film Awards ceremony scheduled to take place on January 16, 2027 in Athens.

A total of 68 feature films have been shortlisted for a possible nomination for the European Film Awards, with the winners voted for by members of the European Film Academy.

Forty-five films are selected for the fiction shortlist including Cannes 2026 Palme d’Or winner Fjord , Venice Golden Lion winner Woman Unknown and awards season frontrunners such as La Bola Negra and Coward .

Related Stories

'Elsinore' And 'La Bola Negra' Continue Awards Momentum With Wins At Hamptons Film Festival

Critics Choice Documentary Awards Nominations: '14th' Nabs 6; Elizabeth Holmes Doc, 'Once Upon A Time In Harlem', 'Nuisance Bear' Land 5 Each

The 15 titles in the documentary shortlist include bombshell documentary NAZA and French box office break out Whispers in the Woods . The animation shortlist includes festival breakouts In Waves , Iron Boy and Jim Queen .

Watch on Deadline

Representing 40 European countries, the films bring together established and emerging filmmakers, including directors working across borders. Twenty-five films are directed or co-directed by women.

Voted on by more than 5,700 cinema professionals based in some 50 countries across Europe, the European Film Awards have placed themselves at the heart of the wider awards season following a move to a January slot from the 2026 ceremony onwards, having taken place in December for many years.

The January 16, 2027 slot once again falls the day after the end of nomination voting in the Academy Awards on January 15, and before the January 21 nominations announcement. The Golden Globes will also be done and dusted with its 2027 ceremony set for January 10.

With campaigning largely on hold ahead of the Academy Awards nominations announcement, the January 16 slot allows European teams in the running to return to Europe from L.A. for the ceremony in Athens, before hitting the campaign trail again if they have made it on to the final Oscar shortlists.

The 38th ceremony in Berlin earlier this year saw Norwegian director Joachim Trier’s Sentimental Value sweep the board to win best film, director, screenwriter for Eskil Vogt and Trier, as well as best actor and actress for Stellan Skarsgård and Renate Reinsve respectively, and best score for Hania Rani. It then went on to win Best International Feature Film at the Oscars.

Nominations in the European Film Award categories of best film, documentary, animation, director, actress, actor, screenwriter, casting director, cinematographer, composer, costume designer, editor, make-up and hair artist, production designer and sound as well as for the Discovery – Prix Fipresci award will be announced on 14 November 2026 during the Thessaloniki International Film Festival.

editorial_title_zh: 伊塔洛·隆迪内拉在伊莫拉带来东地中海难民的奥德赛之旅与海难
editorial_excerpt_zh: 将于10月17日在伊莫拉圣多梅尼科博物馆开幕并持续至2027年2月7日，摄影师伊塔洛·隆迪内拉的个展“最后的海滩：东地中海难民的奥德赛之旅与海难”文章 伊塔洛·隆迪内拉在伊莫拉带来……

"translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/repository/media/2026/10/Italo-Rondinella_Or-1024x683.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "伊塔洛·隆迪内拉", "credit": "Exibart", "translated": true}]

article_text:
Italo Rondinella vive, dal 2013, in Turchia. Da lì documenta il fenomeno migratorio della cosiddetta rotta orientale, cioè quella che dalle coste turche conduce i migranti, provenienti soprattutto da Siria, Afghanistan e Iraq, verso Grecia, Cipro e Bulgaria. Una rotta che tra il 2015 e il 2016 ha conosciuto il suo momento di massimo afflusso con quattrocentomila afgani e duecentomila iracheni.

Che cosa significhi, o cosa resti del vivere in quella zona e documentare ciò che avviene, prende forma visibile al Museo di San Domenico di Imola, che apre i suoi spazi a Ultima spiaggia. Odissee e naufragi dei migranti nel Mediterraneo orientale , che riaccende un faro sull’intricato fenomeno migratorio scegliendo come prospettiva quella degli oggetti abbandonati o comunque depositati dal mare lungo il litorale turco a seguito dei numerosi naufragi.

Curata dal direttore di Imola Musei, Diego Galizzi , insieme a Giorgio Bolognesi e Luigi Foschini , la mostra non è soltanto un racconto di vite sopravvissute: certo, Rondinella le racconta, ma proprio facendolo, nel 2017, si imbatte in una nuova storia e decide di raccontarla in modo diverso, coinvolgendo non solo la vista ma anche il senso dell’udito e, volendo, anche quello del tatto. Nasce così un progetto che attraverso fotografie, suoni e frammenti di vita vera, racconta il fenomeno migratorio e le sue contraddizioni dal punto di vista di ciò che, appunto, resta.

Scarpe, biberon, reggiseni, pettini, chiavi, fotografie, salvagenti, medicinali, documenti, vestiti sbiaditi dalla salsedine e dal sole abbandonati sulle rocce o arrivati in riva insieme alla posidonia strappata dal fondale. A questi oggetti Rondinella affida il suo racconto, mettendoli in contrapposizione con le immagini e i suoni registrati sulla spiaggia (lo sciabordio delle onde sulla riva, le voci di bambini, mamme e venditori ambulanti di gelati) dove a poche decine di chilometri i bagnanti godevano del mare, ignari, forse, della tragedia umana che si stava consumando a due passi da lì.

«La questione migratoria – spiega Italo Rondinella – rappresenta una delle principali sfide di questo millennio, a cui l’Europa e l’Italia hanno il dovere di rispondere. Le risposte finora sono state inadeguate e i drammatici naufragi nel Mediterraneo ne sono una vergognosa testimonianza. Questa sfida non è solo un’emergenza umanitaria, ma riguarda il futuro di un continente che ha bisogno di rinnovarsi attraverso la solidarietà e l’integrazione. Mantenere alto il livello dibattito pubblico su questo tema è il primo baluardo contro la retorica di chi, in politica e nei media, manipola e terrorizza l’opinione pubblica».

Ultima spiaggia. Odissee e naufragi dei migranti nel Mediterraneo orientale è, dunque, non soltanto una mostra, ma anche, e soprattutto, un atto ben preciso: quello di parlare, quello di continuare a parlare, condiviso da Rondinella e dal Museo stesso.

«Oggi l’attualità bussa forte anche alle porte musei. Portando all’attenzione del pubblico il progetto fotografico di Italo Rondinella, Imola Musei – commenta il direttore Diego Galizzi – risponde al dovere etico della testimonianza, sottraendo per certi versi il dramma dei migranti alla pura e chiassosa cronaca, per restituirlo alle coscienze. Scegliendo di focalizzarsi sugli oggetti lasciati dai migranti anziché sui loro corpi, Rondinella rifiuta la spettacolarizzazione del dolore, restituendo piuttosto dignità e sacralità a migliaia di esistenze. Le sue immagini sono frammenti di un’archeologia del presente che ci proiettano in una dimensione storica in cui, da sempre, il Mediterraneo è stato teatro di connessioni e di civiltà».

Tracce del passaggio di donne e uomini in cerca di libertà, testimoni muti di tragedie umane e speranze mancate che Italo Rondinella ha sistematicamente fotografato e poi raccolto richiamano la nostra attenzione affinché non si distolga lo sguardo da una delle vicende più drammatiche e insieme più costitutive del nostro tempo: «Significa assumersi una precisa responsabilità», commenta l’Assessore alla Cultura Giacomo Gambi .

The 2026 Gotham Film Awards nominations are in, setting the stage for the next phase of the movie awards season. While last year’s nominations and wins were topped by “One Battle After Another,” which went on to win the Best Picture Oscar, the organization decided to show some “Tender Loving Care” to more films this time around. The new Mike Leigh film is among five nomination leaders this year, along with “All of a Sudden,” “Clarissa,” “La Gradiva,” and “The Invite.” Each scored four nominations.

The 2026 nominations also mark the return of the Gotham Audience Award after a six-year hiatus. The honor celebrates films that transcend the screen to become defining cultural moments, capturing audiences’ attention through their impact, reach, and resonance. Gotham members will vote to determine the winner, and the award will be presented to the film’s credited director(s) and producer(s). (In short, the prize indexes a film’s popularity in culture through audience response and box office.)

This year, the Gotham Audience Award nominees were curated from films submitted to The Gothams for consideration, measured by opening-weekend per-theater average against the highest-rated and most-watched films of 2026, as reported in box office tracking and on Letterboxd. Notable films not submitted for any Gotham Awards consideration include “The Odyssey” and “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.

“It’s a pleasure to announce this year’s nominees. It has been a remarkable year for film, with audiences turning out in theaters for bold, distinctive work from first-time filmmakers and established artists alike,” said Jeffrey Sharp, Gotham Film & Media Institute executive director. “This year’s nominations, alongside our Tributes and the return of the Audience Award, reflect that abundance and celebrate the creative community that has been at the heart of The Gothams for more than three decades.”

While the Gotham nominations committees are made up of clusters of critics, filmmakers, and tastemakers rather than an 11,000-member Academy, these awards often help put less publicized films onto Oscar voters’ radars. Example: Kelly O’Sullivan and Alex Thompson’s extraordinary “Mouse” in the Best Feature category, which premiered way back at the Berlin Film Festival and is primed for an awards-season relaunch.

See the full list of Gotham Film Awards 2026 nominations below. The ceremony takes place on November 30 in New York City.

article_text:
Art the Clown is back for another round of big-screen terror.

The “ Terrifier ” trilogy is headed back to theaters, just in time for spooky season. 2016’s “Terrifier,” 2022’s “Terrifier 2″ and 2024’s “Terrifier 3″ will have showtimes at Regal theaters nationwide on Halloween weekend, from Oct. 29-31. The re-release is presented by the video game “Dead by Daylight” and Behaviour Interactive, with support from distributors Cineverse and Epic Pictures.

Related Stories

Amanda Seyfried Rejects Sex Scenes and Turned Down a TV Series Where 'I'd Have to Have Sex All the Time': I Don't Want to Be 'Naked With a Stranger'

'You Can See Everything': That Shocking, Meta Twist With [SPOILER] Explained in Elizabeth Holmes Doc

Ticketholders for any of the films will be entered into a drawing to win a download code for “Dead by Daylight,” which features “Terrifier” anti-hero Art the Clown as a character. All Regal Crown Club members who buy tickets will receive a code for an in-game cosmetic — in this case, Art’s retro flower sunglasses.

The gory, low-budget “Terrifier” movies became surprise box office sensations with the second and third chapters. “Terrifier 2″ made $16.8 million worldwide from a $250,000 budget and “Terrifier 3″ wowed with over $90 million worldwide from a $2 million budget.

Damien Leone wrote and directed the trilogy, which stars David Howard Thornton as Art the Clown. Lauren LaVera plays Sienna Shaw, the series’ protagonist, who joins in the second chapter.

In an interview with Variety when the third film was released, Leone discussed how he pushed things to the limit in his films.

“I’m always looking for lines to get up to, to push the boundary,” he said. “Maybe just step right over it. But you can absolutely fall into a level of extreme distaste that I’m trying not to do.”

Watch the trailer for the first “Terrifier” below.

第42回「北野 大茶湯 」

出演：仲野太賀 池松壮亮 吉岡里帆 浜辺美波 坂井真紀 宮澤エマ 倉沢杏菜 大東駿介 吉岡秀隆 松下洸平 他

公式HP: https://one.nhk/toyotomi-kyodai 公式X アカウント: https://x.com/nhk_toyotomi 公式Instagram アカウント： https://www.instagram.com/nhk_toyotomi/

ハッシュタグは #豊臣兄弟

秀吉（池松壮亮さん）が普請させた京の聚楽第が完成。秀次（山田涼介さん）は、その祝いに盛大な茶会を開くことを提案する。

天下一統も道半ばのなか時期尚早だと秀長（仲野太賀さん）は反対するが、秀吉は利休（吉岡秀隆さん）に命じ、大名も商人も百姓も参加できる大茶会を北野で催すと決める。

茶会は盛況となるが、会場でキリシタン追放令に恨みを抱く者による刃傷沙汰が！

さらに佐々成政（白洲迅さん）が治める肥後で大規模な一揆が勃発し…。

article_text:
In the documentary “ You Can See Everything ,” Elizabeth Holmes tries to convince Nathan Fielder that she was misquoted by The New York Times.

“They’re not playing me. They’re playing a character I created,” the disgraced Theranos founder is quoted as saying in a 2023 profile. She was talking about actors portraying her in movies and TV shows, like Amanda Seyfried in Hulu’s “The Dropout.” Holmes disputed the quote back when the piece was published, arguing that what she actually said was, “They’re playing a character they created.”

Related Stories

Harry Styles 'Together, Together' Tour Doc Coming From John Wilson, Universal Pictures Content Group (EXCLUSIVE)

Harry Styles Waltzes His Way Through 'Coming Up Roses' Music Video

Fielder is fascinated with the quote dispute because he believes it speaks to a larger debate: Does the media have an agenda to distort Holmes’ image, or does Holmes have delusions about how she portrays herself?

The documentary provides no answer to the question. Holmes’ partner, Billy Evans, says in the film that he taped her interview with the Times, but he is not able to show evidence of her being misquoted. And an intertitle card at the end of the film says Fielder and his co-director Lance Oppenheim were able to reach The New York Times journalist, who stood by her reporting but also did not provide evidence of the quote. The paper asserts that, at the time, the reporter “went over her interview notes with her editors and they confirmed that the story’s quote was accurate. We relayed this to Holmes and considered it settled.”

The journalist, Amy Chozick, has now spoken about the kerfuffle to The New York Times itself. She said the disputed quote was uttered while Holmes and Chozick were on a walk outside their rented beach home in California, and Evans was at the gym.

“As we walked, I told Holmes that I heard Jennifer Lawrence had recently pulled out of portraying her in a movie. She looked over at me, and said: ‘They’re not playing me. They’re playing a character I created,'” Chozick told the Times. “As she walked a couple of steps ahead, I wrote down her exact words in my notebook.”

She added, “Every night when I’ve been out reporting, I go through my notebook and put a star next to anything I think is a particularly important moment or quote and I highlight it and flag that page with a Post-it note. This quote was highlighted and the page had a Post-it.”

Chozick was not recording audio of this portion of the interview; she was only jotting notes down by hand. She lamented the fact that she did not hold onto the notebook and therefore has no hard evidence of the exchange.

“A lot of people’s most honest, on-the-record reflections come when I turn off my recorder and just take notes,” Chozick said. “I wasn’t going to put a recorder in Holmes’s face as we walked on the beach. I take notes constantly, to jot down important quotes and details and to incorporate my impressions in real time. I generally keep my reporter’s notebooks for a couple of years before getting rid of them. My editors confirmed the quote with me in 2023, and I thought the matter was resolved. I didn’t anticipate that the quote would become a part of a documentary years later. Of course, now I really wish I’d kept that notebook.”

Chozick denied Evans’ claim in “You Can See Everything” that he recorded all of their conversations. “I spent several days with Holmes and Evans, always on the record,” she said. “We did several formal interviews at the kitchen table and on the couch when we both recorded the conversations. But a lot of the most revealing moments came when the recorders were turned off.”

When asked why readers should trust the accuracy of the quote in the absence of proof, Chozick said, “It’s a fair question,” but explained the extent to which Holmes spoke about the character she created at Theranos, which was defined by black turtlenecks, red lipstick and a deep voice. Talking about her public persona, Holmes told Chozick, “Maybe people picked up on that not being authentic, since it wasn’t.” She did not dispute that quote, or any of the surrounding context.

“My late mentor, David Carr, used to say writing a profile is like holding a mirror up to a person. They don’t always like what they see. I’ve profiled some of the most controversial figures of our time, and I am always surprised by which details or quotes strike a nerve with them,” Chozick said. “But this one stood out to me because Holmes spoke openly, over several days, about the persona she created at Theranos. This was the first interview she had given since the blood-testing company imploded, and she looked and sounded like a completely different person from the public figure people remembered. How and why she’d created that persona was a topic that we returned to repeatedly.”

article_text:
UPDATED, 10:40 AM: The Santa Barbara Film Festival on Friday named the recipients of its 2027 Virtuoso Awards. The honorees and their films are Carrie Coon ( The Liberation ), Mariana di Girolamo ( Wild Horse Nine ), Rosalind Eleazar ( Misty Green ), Jordan Firstman ( Club Kid ), Anthony Ippolito ( I Play Rocky ), Jaafar Jackson ( Michael ), Inde Navarrette ( Obsession ) and Kate O’Flynn ( Tender Loving Care ).

Related Stories

‘Wild Horse Nine’ Trailer: Martin McDonagh’s Venice Hit Saddles Up For Awards-Season Run

2026-27 Awards Season Calendar: Oscars, Emmys, Grammys, Guilds & More

Per SBIFF, the Virtuoso Award recognizes a select group of talent whose exceptional work in films has placed them at the center of the conversation around the year’s most noteworthy cinematic performances.

“This year’s Virtuosos are a powerhouse group from the most talked-about films of the season. I think it’s especially fitting that so many of them are international performers and I can’t wait to help welcome them all to Santa Barbara,” said Karger.

Watch on Deadline

The 42nd Santa Barbara International Film Festival is set for February 3-13 in the coastal California city. See below for the fest’s other 2027 awards winners revealed so far.

PREVIOUSLY: John Malkovich , a two-time Oscar nominee who won the Best Actor prize at this year’s Venice Film Festival for his work in Martin McDonagh’s upcoming Wild Horse Nine , has been selected to receive the Santa Barbara Film Festival’s Outstanding Performer of the Year Award.

The honor will be bestowed during the 42nd annual SBIFF, which runs February 3-13, 2027.

Malkovich leads off the awards announcements from the fest, which has become a valued stop on the movie-awards circuit. Last year, Michael B. Jordan won the same award ahead of his eventual Best Actor Oscar win for Sinners .

Other SBIFF honorees in the category include Ralph Fiennes, Bradley Cooper, Cate Blanchett, Will Smith, Aunjanue Ellis, Sacha Baron Cohen, Adam Driver, Rami Malek, Margot Robbie and Allison Janney, Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, Brie Larson and Saoirse Ronan, Steve Carell, Cate Blanchett, Jennifer Lawrence, Viola Davis, James Franco, Colin Firth, Penélope Cruz, Angelina Jolie, Helen Mirren, Heath Ledger, Kate Winslet and Charlize Theron.

In the black comedy Wild Horse Nine , Malkovich stars with Sam Rockwell as a pair of CIA agents who travel from Santiago to Easter Island on the eve of the 1973 Chilean coup, confronting their dark pasts and becoming entangled in present-day conspiracies. The Searchlight Pictures pic hits theaters November 6.

“A legendary actor gives this year in Wild Horse Nine his best performance to date in which he combines pathos, volatility, vulnerability and tenderness,” SBIFF executive director Roger Durling said Thursday in a release announcing the award. “It’s a high-wire act that shows us what a commanding artist he is, and we are thrilled to be honoring him with our Outstanding Performer of the Year Award.”

article_text:
At the Gibbes Museum of Art in Charleston, South Carolina, USA, ‘Fighting for Freedom: Black Craftspeople and the Pursuit of Independence’ explores how African American artisans used creativity, skill and craftsmanship to assert agency and pursue liberation.

How can an everyday object become an expression of resistance? ‘Fighting for Freedom: Black Craftspeople and the Pursuit of Independence’ examines Black artisans’ contributions to American history, challenging narratives that have long overlooked their creative and cultural legacies.

Spanning the American Revolution to the present, the exhibition brings together more than 30 objects, including furniture, ceramics, metalwork, textiles, tools and personal accessories. Created by both free and enslaved craftspeople, these works reveal how artistic skill became a means of asserting identity, independence and agency within systems of oppression.

Through objects dating from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, the exhibition foregrounds the experiences of recognised makers alongside those whose names have been lost to history. Their craftsmanship offers insight into the relationship between labour, creativity and the pursuit of freedom.

Organised by the Daughters of the American Revolution Museum in partnership with the Black Craftspeople Digital Archive, the exhibition invites visitors to reconsider Black artisans’ role in shaping America’s material and cultural heritage.

This exhibition will be on view at the Gibbes Museum of Art , Charleston, South Carolina, from 16 October 2026 to 9 May 2027.

article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "To receive Morning Links in your inbox every weekday, sign up for our Breakfast with ARTnews newsletter.", "links": [{"text": "Morning Links", "url": "https://www.artnews.com/t/morning-links/"}, {"text": "Breakfast with ARTnews", "url": "https://cloud.email.artnews.com/artnews-signup/"}]}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Good morning!"}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "The Louvre has closed due to about 50 protesting arts and culture students blocking its glass pyramid entrance, in the latest sign of what appears to be abating civil unrest that peaked on Saturday and devolved into rioting."}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "Amid a “cyclical downturn” for Art Basel fairs, the company will hold onto its spot in Miami through 2031, thanks to a new deal that reduces annual rent from nearly $1 million to $500,000."}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "A man was struck by dislodged roofing material and died during a walking tour of Frank Lloyd Wright’s Taliesin West home in Scottsdale, Arizona, which has temporarily closed as a result."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "The Headlines"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "LOUVRE BLOCKED . The Louvre was closed Monday due to about 50 protesting arts and culture students, who blocked its glass pyramid entrance, reported Le Figaro . Their action comes on the one-year anniversary of the brazen jewelry heist at the same museum. It follows a massive, nationwide protest on Saturday against social inequality, particularly visible in public schools, which spiraled into looting and riots and continued to a lesser degree Sunday evening. No damage was reportedly done to the Louvre, and protesters were not able to enter the glass pyramid, according to the AFP. T he protesters at the Louvre, including students at art schools such as the associated École du Louvre , said they were angry at the violent response of police to protesters in recent weeks, and wanted to show support for students demanding better conditions in public schools and the rising cost of living. The unrest comes on the eve of Art Basel Paris this week, sparking concerns about the impact this may have on the fair and a packed week of art events throughout the city. Art Basel issued a statement Sunday reassuring visitors that “the fair is proceeding as planned,” while “additional security personnel have been deployed to patrol the perimeter of the fair 24 hours a day.” The opening of Stan Douglas ’s show Parallax at the Jeu de Paume on Sunday was also canceled “out of precaution,” and the surrounding Tuileries gardens were closed for the same reason, a museum spokesperson told ARTnews . To convince officials that the art fair deserved a rent reduction, Art Basel chief executive Noah Horowitz reportedly gave a far less flattering picture of the company’s finances and the art market as a whole. He also threatened to abandon Miami Beach for Las Vegas, or another city. Horowitz said that recently reported profits for the fair’s parent company, MCH, followed years of “extraordinary losses in which MCH almost faced insolvency,” which led them to take “in a large investment from James Murdoch’s Lupa Systems family office to stabilize the business.” All Art Basel fairs were “currently facing a cyclical downturn, the likes of which we haven’t seen since the launch of Art Basel Miami Beach in the early 2000s,” he said. Meanwhile, galleries are limiting fair participation or shuttering in response to a slower market, he added, which is why Art Basel Miami Beach will host 250 galleries this December, instead of 283 article_text:
To receive Morning Links in your inbox every weekday, sign up for our Breakfast with ARTnews newsletter.

Good morning!

The Louvre has closed due to about 50 protesting arts and culture students blocking its glass pyramid entrance, in the latest sign of what appears to be abating civil unrest that peaked on Saturday and devolved into rioting.

Amid a “cyclical downturn” for Art Basel fairs, the company will hold onto its spot in Miami through 2031, thanks to a new deal that reduces annual rent from nearly $1 million to $500,000.

A man was struck by dislodged roofing material and died during a walking tour of Frank Lloyd Wright’s Taliesin West home in Scottsdale, Arizona, which has temporarily closed as a result.

The Headlines

LOUVRE BLOCKED . The Louvre was closed Monday due to about 50 protesting arts and culture students, who blocked its glass pyramid entrance, reported Le Figaro . Their action comes on the one-year anniversary of the brazen jewelry heist at the same museum. It follows a massive, nationwide protest on Saturday against social inequality, particularly visible in public schools, which spiraled into looting and riots and continued to a lesser degree Sunday evening. No damage was reportedly done to the Louvre, and protesters were not able to enter the glass pyramid, according to the AFP. T he protesters at the Louvre, including students at art schools such as the associated École du Louvre , said they were angry at the violent response of police to protesters in recent weeks, and wanted to show support for students demanding better conditions in public schools and the rising cost of living. The unrest comes on the eve of Art Basel Paris this week, sparking concerns about the impact this may have on the fair and a packed week of art events throughout the city. Art Basel issued a statement Sunday reassuring visitors that “the fair is proceeding as planned,” while “additional security personnel have been deployed to patrol the perimeter of the fair 24 hours a day.” The opening of Stan Douglas ’s show Parallax at the Jeu de Paume on Sunday was also canceled “out of precaution,” and the surrounding Tuileries gardens were closed for the same reason, a museum spokesperson told ARTnews . Other galleries, such as Hauser & Wirth , closed their space in the 8th arrondissement on Saturday “as a precaution to protect the team, visitors and staff,” said a representative in an e-mail.

ART BASEL’S ‘CYCLICAL DOWNTURN.’ Following months of heated negotiations, Art Basel will hold onto its spot in Miami through 2031, thanks to a new deal with city officials that reduces the annual rent paid by the fair to the city from nearly $1 million to $500,000, plus additional city credits for police, fire, and EMT services, reports the New York Times . To convince officials that the art fair deserved a rent reduction, Art Basel chief executive Noah Horowitz reportedly gave a far less flattering picture of the company’s finances and the art market as a whole. He also threatened to abandon Miami Beach for Las Vegas, or another city. Horowitz said that recently reported profits for the fair’s parent company, MCH, followed years of “extraordinary losses in which MCH almost faced insolvency,” which led them to take “in a large investment from James Murdoch’s Lupa Systems family office to stabilize the business.” All Art Basel fairs were “currently facing a cyclical downturn, the likes of which we haven’t seen since the launch of Art Basel Miami Beach in the early 2000s,” he said. Meanwhile, galleries are limiting fair participation or shuttering in response to a slower market, he added, which is why Art Basel Miami Beach will host 250 galleries this December, instead of 283 last year.

The Digest

A man was struck by dislodged roofing material and died during a walking tour of Frank Lloyd Wright ’s Taliesin West home in Scottsdale, Arizona, which has temporarily closed as a result. [ ARTnews ]

A new study examining 79 fingerprints on China’s Terracotta Army suggests that women and children helped make the ceramic sculptures alongside adult men. [ Heritage Daily ]

Landlords of The Park Mansion building on the Upper East Side of Manhattan are demanding that socialite Libbie Mugrabi sell her Jean-Michel Basquiat painting to pay the $2.3 million they say she owes them in rent. [ New York Post ]

A fine arts student strike at London’s Goldsmiths University has become the longest at a UK higher education institution in history, lasting 130 days. [ The Art Newspaper ]

You Hong-june , the director of the National Museum of Korea, made a formal apology on Monday for exhibiting a calligraphy work that was wrongly attributed to Korean activist Park Won-geun, when it was, in fact, by a pro-Japanese collaborator during Japan’s rule over Korea. [ The Korea Times ]

The Kicker

LIVING GHOSTS . Ibrahim Mahama ’s major show, “ The Harvest Season ,” opens at the Fondation Cartier in Paris on Thursday, marking “the most ambitious exhibition I’ve done,” he tells ARTnews . The Ghanaian artist who works collectively within a community insists that “the artist is just a vessel, and I see myself as that vessel in order to put all these different things together to do the work that we do.” The show includes Parliament of Ghosts , an ongoing, 2019-begun installation made of discarded train seats, railway sleepers, school furniture, and government archives. To this he has added about 200 royal stools from the Asante Empire . Mahama explained that the stools were often looted before being exhibited in Western museums, where they are placed behind glass. Another new project for the show, Things Fall Apart , reconstructs an abandoned glass bottle manufacturing factory in Ghana, which will eventually go on permanent display in Kumasi, where the artists are planning to build a new institution.

title_original: ANA SEGOVIA: THE OFFICE OF INTER-AMERICAN AFFAIRS PRESENTS
editorial_title_zh: ANA SEGOVIA: THE OFFICE OF INTER-AMERICAN AFFAIRS PRESENTS
editorial_excerpt_zh: 在克里曼祖托画廊（kurimanzutto）纽约空间的首个个展“The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”中，安娜·塞哥维亚（Ana Segovia）重新审视了西部片影像以及睦邻政策的电影档案，以考察美国电影是如何重新诠释各种人物形象的……
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "heading", "text": "在克里曼祖托画廊纽约空间的首个个展The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents中，安娜·塞哥维亚重新审视了西部片影像以及睦邻政策的电影档案，以考察美国电影是如何重新诠释拉丁美洲的人物形象与想象的。通过色彩变奏与取景操作，这位艺术家打破了那些塑造了我们对这些角色认知的性别密码与视觉常规。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "电影不仅在讲故事，还教导我们如何观看、确立等级并固定行为模式。例如，牛仔和高乔人便是这种视觉教育的产物。尽管它们属于不同的历史与地理语境，但两者都已演变为与权威、自给自足和领土统治相关联的男子气概的象征。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在克里曼祖托画廊纽约空间的首个个展The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents中，安娜·塞哥维亚（1991年生于墨西哥城）重返这些人物，以考察特定的性别与民族身份理想是如何构建和流传的，以及当它们的视觉密码不再符合我们的期待时会发生什么。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ana-Segovia-3.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展览“Ana Segovia: The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”现场，克里曼祖托画廊，纽约，2026年。摄影：Zach Hyman", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ana-Segovia-7.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展览“Ana Segovia: The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”现场，克里曼祖托画廊，纽约，2026年。摄影：Zach Hyman", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "绘画是塞哥维亚颠覆这一视觉想象的主要媒介之一。艺术家汲取了拉丁美洲和美国电影中的场景与取景，但改变了电影中传统上伴随男子气概呈现的色彩色调。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "斗篷、靴子、宽松裤子以及高乔人和牛仔服饰的其他标志性元素，摒弃了通常用以识别它们的沉稳大地色，转而呈现出饱和的、文化上与女性相关联的色调。这一转变足以解构某种形象，而这种形象的权威很大程度上依赖于其常规不被察觉。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ana-Segovia-9.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展览“Ana Segovia: The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”现场，克里曼祖托画廊，纽约，2026年。摄影：Zach Hyman", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ana-Segovia-6.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展览“Ana Segovia: The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”，克里曼祖托画廊，纽约，2026年。摄影：Zach Hyman", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这一操作有着塞哥维亚早期与电影关系的渊源。这位艺术家来自一个从事电影制作与导演的家庭，他在成长过程中看着热爱西部片的祖父，培养了对后来融入其创作实践的影像的熟悉感。他对经典黑白电影的记忆也有助于理解他对色彩的兴趣，将其视为一种能够改变场景认知的资源。随着时间的推移，这种形式上的迷恋获得了一种政治维度，因为色彩是介入性别分配与性别立场的一种文化密码。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "从这个意义上说，其作品可以与朱迪斯·巴特勒（Judith Butler）的施事性（performativity）理论联系起来。从这一视角来看，性别并不构成一种自发显现的本质，而是通过规范、行为和常规的重复来产生和被认可的。电影通过提供形体、服饰、姿势和占据空间的方式，积极参与了这一过程，使某些形式的男子气概和女性气概变得自然化。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "绘画与电影的关系是这一探索的核心。塞哥维亚采用了西部片的特征手法，如中景镜头（plano americano）和特写镜头，并将它们转移到画布上。选择突出身体的哪个部分以及从什么距离去观察的电影构图，变成了一种制约我们对角色解读的构图资源。通过将一个场景从电影的叙事序列中剥离出来，绘画使得人们能够在电影运动和连续性转瞬即逝的东西上驻留。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artishockrevista.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ana-Segovia-8.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展览“Ana Segovia: The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents”现场，克里曼祖托画廊，纽约，2026年。摄影：Zach Hyman", "credit": "Artishock", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "作为跨性别者，塞哥维亚也从一种质疑社会用以定义身体的既定类别的经验出发来处理身体。色彩变奏在外观与社会解读之间的这一接触点上起作用。发生改变的不仅是角色的外表，还有我们以为认出他们的那种确定性。", "translated": true}, article_text:
En The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents , su primera exposición individual en kurimanzutto Nueva York, Ana Segovia retoma imágenes del western y archivos cinematográficos de la Política del Buen Vecino para examinar cómo el cine estadounidense ha reinterpretado figuras e imaginarios latinoamericanos. Mediante alteraciones cromáticas y operaciones de encuadre, el artista desestabiliza los códigos de género y las convenciones visuales que han moldeado nuestra percepción de estos personajes.

Más allá de contar historias, el cine también nos enseña a mirar, establece jerarquías y fija modelos de comportamiento. El cowboy y el gaucho, por ejemplo, son figuras de esa suerte de pedagogía visual. Aunque pertenecen a contextos históricos y geográficos distintos, ambos se han transformado en emblemas de una masculinidad asociada con la autoridad, la autosuficiencia y el dominio territorial.

En The Office of Inter-American Affairs Presents , su primera exposición individual en kurimanzutto Nueva York , Ana Segovia (Ciudad de México, 1991) vuelve sobre estos personajes para examinar cómo se construyen y circulan determinados ideales de género y de identidad nacional, y qué sucede cuando sus códigos visuales dejan de responder a nuestras expectativas.

La pintura es uno de los principales medios con los que Segovia trastoca ese imaginario. El artista recupera escenas y encuadres de películas latinoamericanas y estadounidenses, pero altera los registros cromáticos que tradicionalmente han acompañado la representación de la masculinidad en el cine.

Los ponchos, las botas, los pantalones amplios y otros elementos característicos de la vestimenta del gaucho y el cowboy abandonan los colores sobrios y terrosos que suelen identificarlos para adquirir tonalidades saturadas y culturalmente asociadas con lo femenino. El cambio basta para desarticular una imagen cuya autoridad depende, en buena medida, de que sus convenciones pasen inadvertidas.

Esta operación tiene antecedentes en la relación temprana de Segovia con el cine. Proveniente de una familia vinculada con la producción y la dirección cinematográfica, el artista creció observando a su abuelo, aficionado al western , y alimentó una familiaridad con las imágenes que más tarde incorporaría a su práctica. Su recuerdo de las películas clásicas en blanco y negro también ayuda a entender su interés por el color como un recurso capaz de modificar la percepción de una escena. Con el tiempo, esa fascinación formal adquirió una dimensión política, toda vez que el color es una clave cultural que interviene en la asignación de valores y posiciones de género.

En este sentido, su trabajo puede ponerse en relación con la teoría de la performatividad de Judith Butler . El género, desde esta perspectiva, no constituye una esencia que se manifiesta espontáneamente, sino que se produce y se reconoce mediante la reiteración de normas, comportamientos y convenciones. El cine participa activamente en ese proceso al ofrecer cuerpos, vestimentas, poses y maneras de ocupar el espacio que naturalizan determinadas formas de masculinidad y feminidad.

La relación entre pintura y cine es central en esta investigación. Segovia retoma recursos característicos del western , como el plano americano y el primer plano, y los traslada al lienzo. El encuadre cinematográfico, que selecciona qué parte del cuerpo destacar y desde qué distancia observarlo, se convierte en un recurso compositivo que condiciona nuestra lectura del personaje. Al separar una escena de la secuencia narrativa de la película, la pintura permite detenerse en aquello que el movimiento y la continuidad cinematográfica presentan con rapidez.

Como persona trans, Segovia aborda también el cuerpo desde una experiencia que cuestiona las categorías establecidas con las que la sociedad pretende definirlo. La alteración cromática actúa en ese punto de contacto entre apariencia y lectura social. Lo que cambia no es únicamente el aspecto del personaje, sino también la certeza con que creemos reconocerlo.

El alcance político de estas imágenes se amplía con la incorporación de materiales audiovisuales procedentes de la Office of the Coordinator of Inter-American Affairs (OCIAA) , organismo creado por el gobierno estadounidense en 1940, durante la administración de Franklin D. Roosevelt , en el marco de la Política del Buen Vecino .

La institución promovió la circulación de imágenes de América Latina mediante el cine, la radio, publicaciones y exposiciones, con el propósito de fortalecer los vínculos entre Estados Unidos y los países de la región durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Estas producciones iban más allá de simples registros de otras geografías, ya que participaban en la construcción de una imagen de Latinoamérica que fuera reconocida y consumida por públicos de ambos lados del continente.

Segovia llegó a estos archivos durante la investigación para una exposición presentada a comienzos de 2026 en la Fundación Cervieri Monsuárez , en Montevideo, bajo la curaduría de Magalí Arriola . En kurimanzutto Nueva York, dos monitores muestran películas relacionadas con Uruguay y Chile. Un registro sonoro procedente del mismo archivo se extiende por la galería y transforma la experiencia de la visita.

La recuperación de estos documentos permite advertir que la representación de América Latina también ha sido una disputa por el poder de definir sus imágenes. En algunas producciones de la OCIAA, las particularidades históricas y sociales de la región quedan subordinadas a modelos visuales familiares para el público estadounidense.

La figura del gaucho, por ejemplo, se aproxima al arquetipo del cowboy , como si ambos encarnaran una misma idea de masculinidad rural, al margen de las diferencias entre sus respectivos territorios y tradiciones. Esa traducción hacía reconocible las figuras locales para el público estadounidense, pero también simplificaba su historia.

Junto a Gambola (Uruguay) se expone una serie de diez dibujos al carboncillo sobre papel que funciona como una suerte de storyboard del video. Las piezas se disponen sobre un muro cuyo color guarda relación con el de los materiales de la estructura que sirve de soporte a la proyección. Estos elementos, habitualmente ocultos, quedan a la vista y desnudan la construcción del dispositivo de exhibición que alberga la imagen.

Gambola (Uruguay) registra una performance realizada en colaboración con intérpretes uruguayos, en la que la figura del gaucho queda sometida al lenguaje de representación del cine. El plano general, el plano americano y el primer plano recortan el cuerpo de distintas maneras, organizan nuestra atención y desencadenan diferentes aproximaciones al personaje. Al igual que las pinturas de Segovia, la secuencia pone en evidencia que los arquetipos se construyen y perpetúan mediante la repetición de las formas que nos enseñan a reconocerlos.

La Época de Oro del cine mexicano y el western estadounidense son repertorios audiovisuales que han contribuido a fijar personajes y atributos reconocibles, pero también son construcciones susceptibles de ser alteradas. Al intervenir sus colores y encuadres, Segovia interrumpe la familiaridad de esas imágenes y devuelve al primer plano aquello que su repetición había naturalizado: su carácter convencional, su dimensión performática y las relaciones de poder que intervienen en su producción.

Esta maniobra vendría a ser una reescritura desde dentro. Los personajes conservan suficiente familiaridad para que podamos reconocerlos, pero sus arquetipos ya no encajan del todo. En esa distancia entre lo que esperamos ver y lo que efectivamente vemos, la masculinidad no es una condición natural e inmutable, y el imaginario nacional pierde parte de su aparente seguridad. Las imágenes que alguna vez contribuyeron a determinar identidades se convierten, entonces, en un lugar desde el cual interrogar quién las produjo, a qué intereses respondían y qué otras formas de representación pueden surgir de ellas.

"translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "英国拥有属于自己的宏大黑人女性群体档案。加勒比女性在战后抵达英国，成为国家医疗服务体系（NHS）中的护士、助产士、清洁工和护理人员。温德鲁斯（Windrush）一代的女性及其后代也在其中。此外，还有在大学、企业、医院、媒体、法律、学校、政府和艺术领域工作的黑人女性。那些非洲和加勒比血统的女性，其历史无法被压缩进单一的英籍黑人经历之中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我最初曾想，纪念柱上的那位女性是否应该由其中一位NHS的女性来担任。将那些日常劳作切实维持了英国人生命的黑人女性树为纪念碑，具有一种强大的力量。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "但这却引出了另一个问题。为什么黑人女性必须先为英国服务，英国才允许她成为纪念碑？为什么她必须先经历护理、清洁、移民、挣扎、抚育或克服种种困难，才能赢得这座底座？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "塞尔夫拒绝这种要求是正确的。黑人女性应当能够简简单单地穿着蓝色长裙走在某处，而无需通过牺牲来证明其存在的正当性。问题不在于塞尔夫没有雕刻出一名护士，而在于“everywoman”（每一个女性）这个词承载了巨大的代表性负担。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "英国自身已经拥有了一段虽短却颇具启示意义的公共雕塑中的黑人女性造型史。《青铜女人》（Bronze Woman，2008）基于塞西尔·诺布雷加（Cécile Nobrega）的诗歌与倡议构思，承载着加勒比移民与母亲身份的历史。马丁·詹宁斯（Martin Jennings）的《玛丽·西科尔》（Mary Seacole，2016）矗立在圣托马斯医院外。托马斯·J·普赖斯（Thomas J Price）的《伸出援手》（Reaching Out，2020）展现了一位全神贯注于手机的当代匿名黑人女性。巴斯利·沃森（Basil Watson）的《国家温德鲁斯纪念碑》（National Windrush Monument，2022）将一位女性置于跨代移民家庭之中。维罗尼卡·莱恩（Veronica Ryan）则在《释迦（番荔枝科）》、《面包果（桑科）》和《刺果番荔枝（番荔枝科）》（Custard Apple (Annonaceae) , Breadfruit (Moraceae) and Soursop (Annonaceae) ，2021）中完全避开了对黑人身体的具象呈现，而是让物品承载加勒比移民与记忆的历史。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "第四基座本身也提供了另一个先例。2003年，生于尼日利亚的英国雕塑家索卡里·道格拉斯·坎普（Sokari Douglas Camp）凭借《No-o War-r No-o-War-r》（2003）入围短名单，这是一组手持反战标语的不锈钢抗议者雕塑，旨在回应当时占据特拉法加广场的游行示威。她让该地点近期的历史进入了拟议的雕塑之中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我不禁在想，如果这个基座彻底拒绝单一性，结果会怎样？想象一下，环绕着它，你遇见的不是“这位”黑人女性，而是“多位”黑人女性。她们有着不同的年龄、身体状况以及与伦敦的联系。一个可能在城里工作，另一个在NHS、学术界或艺术界。也许这些职业都不需要被宣告。重点不是开出一张值得尊敬的黑人成就清单，而是拒绝那种认为一个身体可以代表所有人的期待。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我提出这一点，并不是认为这就是塞尔夫本该创作的雕塑。艺术家并不欠评论家们一个我们更希望他们创作的艺术品。我之所以想象这些多重女性的形象，只是为了暴露出单一的黑人“everywoman”概念内部的矛盾：当要求一个身体去代表所有人时，所有让这种普遍性成为不可能的差异便开始显现出来。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这里存在一个残酷的讽刺。持种族主义态度的旁观者看着《蓝色女士》，找到了嘲弄黑人身体的机会。而持庆祝态度的旁观者则看到了代表性、自信与进步。这两种反应都会阻碍我们对图像本身提出更深刻的质疑。也许，当我们在面对其到来时不再仅仅满足于欢呼，代表性才算走向成熟。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "有一个非洲谚语经常与奇努阿·阿切贝（Chinua Achebe）对历史的思考联系在一起：“在狮子拥有自己的历史学家之前，狩猎的历史将永远歌颂猎人。”它的力量在于署名权。猎人不只拥有武器，他还拥有故事。他决定了狩猎如何被铭记、谁成为英雄、谁仅仅沦为猎物。谁被允许去描述谁？谁在控制档案馆？谁在生产图像？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "几个世纪以来，黑人一直在争取成为自己图像创作者的权利。当代文化中充满了“终于能够‘讲述我们自己的故事’”以及“说出我们的真相”这样的话语。这些是重要的成果。但署名权并非脱离权力体系而存在。问题不仅在于谁能讲故事，还在于机构选择委托、提升和验证哪些故事。毕竟，可见性并不等同于自主性：被看见并不必然意味着决定自己获得可见性的条件。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "那么，当狮子终于成为历史学家，但故事得以显现的条件仍然由曾经给予猎人特权的机构所塑造时，会发生什么？答案当然不可能是狮子的叙述不容置喙。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "查巴拉拉·塞尔（Tschabalala Self）完全有权将这个女人置于特拉法加广场。她完全有权夸大她、重新宣示她、给她穿上蓝色衣服，并坚持认为她不仅代表黑人女性气质，更代表全人类。而我们这些看着她的人，同样有权去追问：究竟有哪些历史随她一同登上了柱基。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "或许，第四基座上站错了黑人女性。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这并不是因为英国某处正有一个更体面的黑人女性在等待这个基座。也不是因为站在那里的那个女人不够具有英国特色、不够谦逊、不够英雄主义或不够卓越。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "或许她错了，是因为“一个黑人女性能够成为黑人‘每一个人’”这种期许本身从一开始就是错的。或许，终于有机会讲述狩猎故事的最有意义的结果，并非我们所有人对这个故事达成一致。而是我们终于可以为此争论不休了。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "阿约·阿金万德（Ayọ̀ Akínwándé）是一位英籍尼日利亚艺术家，其创作横跨绘画、镜头媒介、装置、声音与行为艺术。他的作品探讨权力、社会政治现实以及传统与现代的交织。他同时也是一名策展人、研究者和作家，其国际展览与策展项目包括联合策划首届拉各斯双年展（2017）。", "translated": true}]

Beginning with a conversation between Nicole Eisenman and curator Mark Godfrey, Akínwándé considers how authorship, artistic intention, and public space shape representation, and whether celebrating Black visibility has made its images harder to question. At its centre is a provocative proposition: can one Black woman ever be expected to represent the universal “everywoman”?"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Ayọ̀ Akínwándé"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "On 29 September 2026, I sat in the Royal Institution in London listening to Nicole Eisenman in conversation with curator Mark Godfrey. It was why he disappeared."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "As I understood Eisenman’s explanation that evening, painting offered a different kind of privacy. A painting could be made within the privacy of the studio and might eventually enter another private space, including someone’s home. Sculpture entering the public realm demanded another kind of consideration. My recollection is that Eisenman described becoming more intentional about the figure that would occupy that public space."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The anonymous man did not make that journey. Phyllida Barlow did. Barlow, who died in 2023, had been Eisenman’s friend, mentor and an important influence on her understanding of sculpture. Eisenman also spoke about allowing time after Barlow’s death before publicly presenting the work, so that the gesture could properly honour her. Members of Barlow’s family were in the room that evening. Nicole Eisenman, Hindsight , 2020, Oil on canvas, 208.6 x 165.7 cm / 82 1/8 x 65 1/4 inches © Nicole Eisenman. Photo: Thomas Barratt.", "credit": "ART AFRICA"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "What stayed with me was the distinction Eisenman drew between making an image privately and placing a body publicly. Tschabalala Self, Lady in Blue , 2026. Painted bronze sculpture. Fourth Plinth, Trafalgar Square, London. Commissioned through the Mayor of London’s Fourth Plinth programme. Photo: Ayọ̀ Akínwándé."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/DSC00473-1030x687.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Tschabalala Self, Lady in Blue , 2026. Photo: Ayọ̀ Akínwándé.", "credit": "ART AFRICA"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "I had been thinking about her before Eisenman’s conversation. More accurately, I had been disturbed by her. Listening to Eisenman helped me understand why."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Self is a Black American woman who has achieved one of the most visible public art commissions in the world. Her sculpture also enters a public sphere in which images of Black people continue to attract racist hostility. Self knows this intimately. Her earlier public sculpture Seated (2022) was vandalised at the De La Warr Pavilion."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Since Lady in Blue appeared in Trafalgar Square, I have watched some reactions online descend quickly into racist caricature. The Black female body remains extraordinarily available for public ridicule. Perhaps that is precisely why criticism becomes difficult. But representation cannot mean suspending criticism."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Self has been explicit about the figure she intended to place in Trafalgar Square. At the unveiling, she described Lady in Blue as “an everyday person much like the many who occupy the square daily,” adding that the figure is “striding forward into our collective future with ambition, purpose and optimism.” The Fourth Plinth programme itself describes the commission as an attempt to bring a contemporary “everywoman” to the square. I take that proposition seriously. Self is asking this anonymous Black woman to operate not simply as a representation of Black womanhood, but as an everyday figure with a claim to universality."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "It is a compelling question. But another sits beside it. What kind of Black woman have we chosen to make universal? Tschabalala Self, Lady in Blue , 2026. Painted bronze sculpture. Fourth Plinth, Trafalgar Square, London. Commissioned through the Mayor of London’s Fourth Plinth programme. Photo: Ayọ̀ Akínwándé."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/DSC00469-687x1030.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "Tschabalala Self, Lady in Blue , 2026.
